title: Drop the £2,000 cap on salary-sacrifice pension contributions
description: Budget 2025 limits the pension contributions that can be salary-sacrificed free of National Insurance to £2,000 a year from April 2029. Switch this on to cancel the cap.

baselinePolicy.text: Salary-sacrifice pension contributions above £2,000 a year lose NICs relief from 6 April 2029 (Table 4.1 line 52).
alreadyIncludes: Salary-sacrifice NICs relief capped at £2,000 from April 2029 (Budget 2025, Table 4.1 line 52).

lines.title: Salary Sacrifice: Limit the value of salary sacrificed pension contributions that can receive employee and employer NICs relief to £2,000 per year from 6 April 2029

rawSource.note: Reversal: the Treasury's costing with its sign reversed (positive scorecard values reduce borrowing; here receipts positive means more revenue).

caveats: The Treasury's costing is on the OBR November 2025 forecast, not the March 2026 baseline used here; the difference is small relative to the figures. Effects before the start year are not applied.

considerations.text: The Treasury's scorecard figure is the certified direct costing for the measure, including the behavioural response the Treasury and OBR agreed; see the Budget 2025 policy costings document for the method.
